name: Tartarus-IV
description: Orbital scans indicate ancient automated defense clusters and subterranean sub-munitions have infested the planetary crust. All civilian and industrial activity is suspended under quarantine. As deep-space clearance contractors, your team is deployed to systematically neutralize each fortified sector.
missionDirective: Clear the planet. Sector by sector.
intelDossier: Surface Topology: Dual Geodesic Hexagonal Lattice (42 Sectors)
4 Strategic Fortress Hubs with Subterranean Minefields
38 Territorial Hexes Encased in Heavy Basalt Barrier Walls
Full Orbital Support: Casino Supply Ships & Scrap Collection
Clear All 4 Primary Fortresses to Secure the Planet
